dedupe_keys.name: hydropower dataset for creating operational constraints in aggregated energy system models covering european bidding zones

description: Hydropower dataset for creating operational constraints in aggregated energy system models covering European bidding zones is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Julia Kiehle, Tomi Lindroos (University of Oulu). The dataset was developed to address potential over- and underestimation of hydropower flexibility in highly aggregated, large-scale energy system models. Researchers and modellers can utilise the created generation and ramping constraints to increase the accuracy of their models with regard to hydropower. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
